preconditions: OTP has been generated at t=1000.0s with standard 120-second TTL
input_parameters: phone='0987654321', channel='sms', t0=1000.0, check_1=1120.0s (120s elapsed), check_2=1121.0s (121s elapsed)
execution_steps: 1. Verify OTP at exactly t0 + 120.0s; 2. Verify OTP at t0 + 121.0s

preconditions: User USR-02 exists and status is Active

assertion_logic: tokens['token_type']=='Bearer' and tokens['expires_in']==900 and payload['sub']=='USR-02' and 'book_court' in payload['permissions']

preconditions: Two registered users: one Customer (USR-CUST) and one Field Owner (USR-OWNER)
input_parameters: cust_token (Customer role), owner_token (Field Owner role), permissions=['book_court', 'set_pricing']
execution_steps: 1. Check Customer access to 'book_court'; 2. Check Customer access to 'set_pricing'; 3. Check Field Owner access to 'set_pricing'
expected_result: Customer allowed to book court but strictly forbidden (HTTP 403) from setting pricing; Field Owner allowed to set pricing
assertion_logic: auth.authorize(cust_token, 'book_court') is True and auth.authorize(cust_token, 'set_pricing') is False and auth.authorize(owner_token, 'set_pricing') is True
